'''The Dove Takes Flight''' is a [[sword form]]. Nothing is known about the form except the name. [[Rand al'Thor]] once used it when fighting with [[Ishamael|Ba'alzamon]].{{ref/book|2|47}} The form was also used by [[Eamon Valda]] against [[Galadedrid Damodred]] during their fight. Galad defended with [[Kingfisher Circles the Pond]].{{ref/book|11|p}}
